name: Sasha
source:
Sasha is an employee of the supermarket where Slava gets a job; a positive young man who works part-time at "Pomidorochka" in his spare time (and not so much) from the institute.

Despite his frivolity, he is often loved by everyone — from the most dissatisfied customer to Nikolai Mikhailovich; and because of this trait, he is constantly exploited to resolve conflicts with visitors and within the team.

He knows sign language, so he is the only one in the entire store who can communicate with Vasilisa "directly".

He knows sign language, so he is the only one in the entire store who can communicate with Vasilisa "directly".
